summary.text: Joe Webster, listed by Ballotpedia as Joseph Webster, is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 150, having taken office on December 1, 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired Air Force colonel, he founded Convergence Music and has worked as an adjunct professor of national security policy.

paragraphs.text: Webster graduated from the U.S. Air Force Academy in 1980, received a master's degree in English from Wright State University in 1984 and a master's degree in national security policy from the U.S. Naval War College in 2001, and holds a Ph.D. in public policy from George Washington University.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1980 to 2004, attaining the rank of colonel, and in the Air Force Reserves from 2004 to 2010.
Webster has also served as vice president of Gestalt L.L.C. and Accenture, founded Convergence Music in 2014, and began working as an adjunct and online professor in national security policy in 2017.

In the 2023-2024 session, Webster was assigned to the Appropriations, Finance, State Government, and Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness committees, chairing subcommittees on Government Information Technology and Communication and on Military and Veterans Facilities.
